title: Bug 658681: [Master Data Management] Support certificate secret for cross-environment synchronization
summary: Cross-environment master data synchronization now supports certificate authentication as an alternative to client secrets, with certificate storage in isolated storage and automatic validation of expiration and private keys.
key_points: Adds Authentication Type field to connection wizard, defaulting to Client Secret with Certificate option
Certificate stored securely in isolated storage with thumbprint and expiration date metadata
Validates certificate has private key, opens with password, and is not expired
Token acquisition uses OAuth2.AcquireTokensWithCertificate when certificate is stored
Cleanup on environment copy and setup deletion removes all stored credentials from isolated storage
